title: Brand Manager
description: Key Responsibilities:1. Brand Strategy & Growth Management:-Develop and execute annual and long-term brand strategies aligned with business objectives.Define brand positioning, architecture, and communication strategy to strengthen brand equity.Identify growth opportunities through market expansion, portfolio optimization, and innovation.Monitor competitor activities, category trends, and consumer behavior to drive strategic decisions.2. Product & Innovation Management:-Lead new product development (NPD), renovations, and line extensions based on consumer insights.Manage product lifecycle including launch planning, performance tracking, and optimization.Work closely with R&D, packaging, procurement, and supply teams to deliver successful launches.Ensure innovation pipeline supports category growth targets.3. Marketing & Communication Execution:-Plan and execute integrated 360 marketing campaigns across TV, digital, social media, retail, and e-commerce platforms.Oversee creative development, media strategy, and agency management.Ensure consistent brand messaging across all consumer touchpoints.Drive digital-first marketing initiatives and consumer engagement programs.4. Commercial & Sales Collaboration:-Partner with Sales and Trade Marketing teams to develop go-to-market strategies and promotional plans.Support channel-specific initiatives including modern trade, general trade, and e-commerce platforms.Provide brand guidance for in-store visibility, merchandising, and activation programs.Monitor sales performance and recommend corrective actions to achieve targets.5. Consumer & Market Insights:-Leverage market research, panel data (Nielsen/Kantar), and consumer analytics to guide decision-making.Track brand health metrics such as awareness, penetration, repeat purchase, and loyalty.Translate insights into actionable marketing and innovation strategies.6. Financial & P&L Management:-Own brand P&L including revenue growth, margins, and marketing investments.Manage A&P budgets and ensure effective ROI on campaigns and promotions.Support pricing strategies and profitability improvement initiatives.7. Stakeholder & Agency Management:-Manage relationships with creative, media, digital, and research agencies.Collaborate with internal stakeholders including Supply Chain, Finance, and Operations to ensure execution excellence.Lead cross-functional alignment on brand priorities and timelines.
